OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When provided it must be unique across owners.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The display name of the pet owner, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The initials of the pet owner, formatted as the upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

## Summary

I implemented the `registrationDate` feature for owners: when an owner is created without a registration date, it defaults to today's date and is returned in the owner response as `registrationDate` in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

Changes made:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `registrationDate` field (`type: string, format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. The `spring` generator maps `format: date` to `java.time.LocalDate`, which Jackson serializes as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Since `Owner` extends `OwnerFields` via `allOf`, the field appears in the response.

2. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`** — Added a `LocalDate registrationDate` field mapped to a `registration_date` column, with getter/setter.

3. **`src/main/java/.../service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — In `saveOwner`, set `registrationDate` to `LocalDate.now()` when it's null.

4. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — Added the nullable `registration_date DATE` column to the `owners` table (required since the test profile uses `ddl-auto=none` and initializes from `schema.sql`).

MapStruct auto-maps the same-named `registrationDate` property in both directions, so no mapper changes were needed. The `Cp08Tests` acceptance test and all 268 tests pass.
